paper.title: Convergence Guarantees for Deep Epsilon Greedy Policy Learning

settings.name_in_paper: Contextual bandit (policy learning) with i.i.d. states and K actions, nonparametric reward functions
unmapped: Reward functions mu_j(X) must be learnable by the neural network regressor at rate c*sqrt(log(n)/n) (Gyorfi et al. Theorem 16.3)
Context-wise gap: Delta_j(X) >= delta > 0 for every suboptimal j and every X; at least one suboptimal action for every context
settings.definition_quote: Let $X$ be the state vector at some time step $t$ and $Y^j_t$ be the reward of action $j$ at time step $t$ both almost surely bounded. Let $\mu_j(X) := \mathbb{E}(Y^j_t|X)$. ... Assume state $X$ is sampled from an unknown distribution i.i.d. at each time step $t$.

bound.regime: t > t_0 = exp(2K max{e, max_i n_i})

symbols.C_0: 8*sqrt(2)*max_i C_i, C_i the constant in the neural-network regression rate
symbols.delta_gap: lower bound on context-wise gap Delta_j(X) for suboptimal j
symbols.n_i: minimal training size for which the NN rate holds

conditions: Delta_j(X) >= delta_gap > 0 for all suboptimal j and all X
at least one suboptimal action for every context
neural-network regressor satisfies E int |Phi_n - E R|^2 dP <= c sqrt(log n / n) for n large (Gyorfi et al. Thm 16.3)
states and rewards almost surely bounded
holds with probability at least 1 - K*exp(-3 ln(t)/(28K)) over previous choices

source.label: thm:epsilon_greedy_bound
source.quote: Then for every $t > t_0$ with probability at least $1-K\exp(-3 \ln(t)/(28K))$, \delta / (tK) \le \E_{X_t} \E_{I_t} \E_R [ R_*(X_t) - R(X_t) ] \le \frac{\max_i \E_{X_t} \Delta_i(X_t)}{t} + K^{3/2}\frac{C_0}{\delta} \sqrt{\frac{\ln(\ln(t))-\ln(2K)}{\ln(t)}}.

results.notes: Bound is on the instantaneous expected regret at step t (not cumulative), holding w.h.p. over past policy choices; recorded as quantity 'other'. Paper's delta is the gap, renamed delta_gap. Reward range not specified beyond 'almost surely bounded'.

source.label: thm:epsilon_greedy_bound_p
source.quote: Let $\epsilon_t = 1/t^p$ where $0<p<1$. ... Then for every $t > t_0$ with probability at least $1-K\exp\left(-(3 \ t^{-p+1})/(28 (-p+1) K)\right)$, \delta / (K t^p) \le ... \le \frac{\max_i \E_{X_t} \Delta_i(X_t)}{t^p} + K^{3/2}\frac{C_0'}{\delta} \sqrt{\frac{\ln(t^{-p+1})-\ln(2(-p+1)K)}{t^{-p+1}}}.

results.notes: Instantaneous regret at step t. Corollary 3.7 states p = 1/3 optimises this upper bound (rate ~ t^{-1/3}); not recorded separately.
